## What was built

`POST /orders/:id/apply-coupon` with body `{ "couponCode": "..." }`:

- validates the coupon exists, is `ACTIVE`, is inside its `validFrom`/`validUntil` window, meets `minAmountCents`, and has uses left — any failure is HTTP 400
- `FIXED` subtracts the value; `PERCENT` applies the percentage truncated to whole cents; both respect `maxDiscountCents` and never exceed the order amount
- persists `discount_cents`, `final_amount_cents`, `coupon_code` on the order and records the redemption (insert + `used_count` bump in one transaction)
- returns HTTP 200 with the updated order; unknown order still returns 404

Changed: [orderService.ts](/work/src/services/orderService.ts), [routes/orders.ts](/work/src/routes/orders.ts), [orderRepository.ts](/work/src/repositories/orderRepository.ts), [couponRepository.ts](/work/src/repositories/couponRepository.ts), [app.ts](/work/src/app.ts). New tests in [applyCoupon.test.ts](/work/tests/applyCoupon.test.ts) (19 cases).

Verification: `npm run build` passes; `npm test` → 24 passed (2 files).

A couple of judgment calls I recorded in the artifacts rather than guessing silently: a missing/unknown coupon returns 400 (not 404) because the acceptance criteria require 400 for an invalid coupon, and re-applying a coupon recomputes from the order's original amount instead of stacking.
